lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using superlatives to talk about the best, easiest, or most convenient option.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing a service time, transport option, or free-time plan.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Identifying a preferred option among several possibilities.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare three practical options and decide which one is easiest or best for their day.

main_focus.name: common superlatives in practical choices
main_focus.description: Use superlative forms such as bäst, enklast, billigast, närmast, and viktigast when choosing among options.
model_examples: Det enklaste är att boka online.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use superlatives naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: simple reason phrases with för att
avoid_grammar: irregular superlative lists as a grammar lecture

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use common superlatives in practical decision phrases, not as isolated adjective practice.

dialogue_shape.middle: They compare which option is easiest, cheapest, closest, or most important for the situation.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose one option and give a short reason.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat superlatives with different practical criteria

focus: the reason for the final choice

sentence_focus: one sentence with det enklaste är att
one question with vilket alternativ är bäst
one sentence with tidigast or senast
one sentence with det viktigaste är
one sentence stating the final choice
